name: Chamomile
description: A delicate plant with small daisy-like flowers, white petals and a yellow centre. The flowers smell a little like apples.

image.alt: Small white chamomile flowers with yellow centres

uses.title: Tea
uses.text: Dried flowers make a calming cup of tea.

uses.title: Drying
uses.text: Dry the flower heads on paper in a shady, airy place.

uses.title: Garden
uses.text: Hoverflies and small bees visit the flowers.

growingTips.title: Sowing
growingTips.text: Sow the seeds on the soil surface in spring; they need light to sprout.

growingTips.title: Sun
growingTips.text: Full sun gives the most flowers.

growingTips.title: Water
growingTips.text: Water gently until the plants are established.

growingTips.title: Harvest
growingTips.text: Pick the flowers when they are fully open, on a dry day.
